title: A prayer for children and booty

verses.t: May the Gods' Consorts aid us of their own free will, help us to offspring and the winning of the spoil. May Goddesses who quickly listen shelter us, both those on earth and they within the waters' realm.
May the Dames, wives of Gods, enjoy our presents, Rāt, Asvini Indrāni and Agnāyi; May Rodasi and Varunāni hear us, and Goddesses come at the matrons' season.
